newsitem.title: CHINA: Three China firms said to list H shares in June.
newsitem.headline: Three China firms said to list H shares in June.

text.p: Three Chinese companies plan to list H shares in Hong Kong this month, the official China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
H shares are Hong Kong-listed shares in China-incorporated enterprises.

Jiangxi Copper Co Ltd, China First Tractor and Construction Machinery Co Ltd and Beijing Yanshan Petrochemical Corp plan to offer shares to investors in Hong Kong and overseas this month, the newspaper said.
Jiangxi Copper last week offered around 628 million H shares to Hong Kong and overseas investors through a global initial public offering (IPO), it said.
Dealing in the company's H shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange would start on Thursday, it said.
The copper producer would use the HK$1.7 billion in proceeds to repay short-term debts and expand production, it said.
China First Tractor was expected to issue 300 million H shares in an IPO beginning on June 10, the newspaper said.
Trading of the tractor maker's shares in Hong Kong was expected to begin on June 23, it said.

Yanshan Petrochemical also planned to issue shares for a dual listing in Hong Kong and New York this month, the paper said. It gave no details on the number of shares to be issued or the schedule for the issue.
